author: Gordon Thelander
releaseNotes:
1.8.9 - fixes JimB's scan-start error for real. The 1.8.8 diagnostic build showed the cause: he reaches his hub through Hubitat's Remote Admin (remoteaccess.aws.hubitat.com), and this app was building relative URLs for the Scan button, the External systems panel, and the View Automation Map link. A relative path only resolves correctly when the page is being served from the hub's own local address - through Remote Admin it 404s before the request ever reaches the app.

The Scan button and the External systems panel now check, at the moment they're used, whether the browser is on the hub's own origin. If so they use the fast local path as before, with no change in behaviour and no internet dependency. If not, they fall back to Hubitat's cloud API address automatically.

The View Automation Map link can't be corrected the same way - it's rendered by Hubitat's own settings-page framework, which doesn't expose which origin the request came in on. So there are now two links: the existing fast local one, and a second explicit 'via Hubitat cloud' link for anyone reaching the hub remotely.

Reports still welcome on the community thread.
